summary: This week the Spark community focused on several SPIP proposals, including a language‑agnostic UDF protocol, a fixed‑dimension numeric VECTOR type, and an ADBC data source to enable Arrow‑based columnar reads. Parallel discussions explored new join strategies, automated AI code review, and Istio mTLS compatibility for executor communication. A vote on the upcoming Spark 4.2.1 RC1 release was also underway.

highlights.text: Proposal for a language‑agnostic UDF protocol to unify API and execution across Spark Connect client languages

sources.title: SPIP: Language-agnostic UDF Protocol for Spark

highlights.text: Proposal to add a fixed‑dimension numeric VECTOR data type to Spark SQL
